name: laragon-controller
description: Start, stop and monitor your Laragon stack (Apache, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Nginx) from the VS Code sidebar.

laragonController.laragonPath.description: Path to the Laragon installation folder.

laragonController.autoStartOnOpen.description: Start all Laragon services automatically when VS Code opens.

laragonController.pollingInterval.description: Interval in milliseconds between service status checks.

laragonController.defaultBrowser.description: Path to a browser executable used to open http://localhost. Leave empty to use the system default browser.

laragonController.databaseManagerUrl.description: URL to open for phpMyAdmin. Change if you use a different alias or port.

laragonController.adminerUrl.description: URL to open for Adminer. Change if you use a different alias or port.

laragonController.heidiSqlPath.description: Path to heidisql.exe. Leave empty to use <laragonPath>/bin/heidisql/heidisql.exe.

laragonController.services.description: Legacy combined form of the enableService switches. Prefer the individual laragonController.enableService.<name> settings, which override this object when set.

laragonController.enableService.apache.markdownDescription: Show **Apache** on the dashboard. When off, it is hidden and skipped by Start All / Stop All / Restart All.

laragonController.enableService.mysql.markdownDescription: Show **MySQL** on the dashboard. When off, it is hidden and skipped by Start All / Stop All / Restart All.

laragonController.enableService.postgres.markdownDescription: Show **PostgreSQL** on the dashboard. When off, it is hidden and skipped by Start All / Stop All / Restart All.

laragonController.enableService.nginx.markdownDescription: Show **Nginx** on the dashboard. When off, it is hidden and skipped by Start All / Stop All / Restart All.

laragonController.enableService.redis.markdownDescription: Show **Redis** on the dashboard. When off, it is hidden and skipped by Start All / Stop All / Restart All.

laragonController.enableService.memcache.markdownDescription: Show **Memcached** on the dashboard. When off, it is hidden and skipped by Start All / Stop All / Restart All.

laragonController.enableOpenWww.description: Show the "Open www" shortcut in the dashboard and Command Palette.

laragonController.enableOpenLocalhost.description: Show the "Open localhost" shortcut in the dashboard and Command Palette.

laragonController.enablePhpMyAdmin.description: Show the "phpMyAdmin" shortcut in the dashboard and Command Palette.

laragonController.enableHeidiSql.description: Show the "HeidiSQL" shortcut in the dashboard and Command Palette.

laragonController.enableAdminer.description: Show the "Adminer" shortcut in the dashboard and Command Palette.

laragonController.enableTerminal.description: Show the "Terminal" shortcut in the dashboard and Command Palette.

laragonController.enableStartAll.description: Show the "All services" Start/Stop/Restart All controls in the dashboard and Command Palette.
